title: THE DESCENT II · HYROX CHIPPER
vibe: 45 min · green · hard · 5 big stations, 5 run legs, the hill drops and the belt speeds up every leg
why: Fresh legs after two days off, so yesterday's unspent upper work gets fused with a HYROX chipper: full body, high reps, one clock. Every station exits onto a 0.25 mi leg and the grade comes down while the speed goes up.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 6 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day C · flow, ankles for the jumps

items.name: Ankle rolls in the squat ×10/side · toe squats 30s

blocks.title: THE DESCENT II · 26 MIN · FOR TIME
blocks.meta: ONE PASS · 5 STATIONS · 5 RUN LEGS · 2×40 lb · 50 lb · cap 28:00
blocks.format: FOR TIME · chip the station, then RUN LEG, next station · rest only to keep form · count stations cleared, then time
blocks.workRest: Every station exits onto the belt for 0.25 mi. LEG 1 @ 6.5 / 8%. LEG 2 @ 7.0 / 6%. LEG 3 @ 7.5 / 4%. LEG 4 @ 8.0 / 2%. LEG 5 @ 8.5 / 0%. Set the next leg while you walk to the bells.

items.name: S1 · Double thruster 2×40 lb ×30 → RUN LEG 1
items.detail: hip crease below the knee every rep

items.name: S2 · Renegade row 2×40 lb ×40 (20/side) → RUN LEG 2
S3 · Burpee broad jump ×25 → RUN LEG 3
items.detail: chest to the floor, jump forward, turn at the wall

items.name: S4 · Double clean + jerk 2×40 lb ×20 → RUN LEG 4
S5 · Bench dips ×30 + pullover 50 lb ×20 → RUN LEG 5
items.detail: couch edge · lying, slow behind the head

blocks.noteGreen: Log stations cleared, finish time, RPE, and whether 8.5 flat was the right final leg.
blocks.text: ★ THRUSTER — bells in the rack, full squat, stand and drive the bells overhead in one motion. ★ JERK — dip, drive, dip under, stand; knees bent when the bells lock out. ★ BURPEE BROAD JUMP — land soft, knees over toes. ★ RUN LEG — step on moving, quick feet on the hill, open the stride as it flattens.

items.name: Dead bug 35 lb ×10/side
items.detail: bell held over the chest, low back down
